selectionMethod: The six-track assignment is the compiled membership of rcap-dc-custom-pleading. This integration record narrows implementation proof to the two routes for which the worker produced complete templates and records the other four as explicit typed stops.
reusedArchitecture: The Mississippi custom-pleading renderer, resolver, fulfillment model and final-PDF assembler are reused unchanged. The District implementation is registered only inside the focused verifier and is not added to the shared runtime registry.

selectedTracks.legalName: Motion for Expungement on Grounds of Actual Innocence, D.C. Code § 16-803
knownLimitations: The participant supplies the statement of points and authorities, exhibits, affidavits and other supporting material; LegalEase does not decide whether the evidentiary showing is sufficient.
The participant must confirm the current Criminal Division filing channel and fee treatment with the clerk.
The participant identifies the prosecuting authority from the case caption; the packet does not decide whether the United States Attorney or District Attorney General handled the case.
Prosecutor opposition, a court-ordered response, a hearing or disputed evidence requires attorney handoff.
requiredBeforeFiling: Attach the participant-authored statement of points and authorities and all supporting exhibits or affidavits.
Confirm the filing channel, fee treatment and any current Seal Team requirement with the Criminal Division.
Confirm and complete service on the prosecuting authority shown by the participant's case record.

selectedTracks.legalName: Motion to Correct a Misattributed Arrest Record, D.C. Code § 16-806(g)
selectedTracks.publicName: Motion to correct a misattributed arrest record
knownLimitations: The route corrects publicly available records; it does not seal them.
The participant may use the route only when no fingerprints were taken at arrest and no other reliable identification was presented.
The source requires a sworn attestation but does not resolve whether the Criminal Division also requires notarization.
The participant must confirm the current filing channel, service address and fee treatment with the clerk.
requiredBeforeFiling: Confirm from the record that no fingerprints were taken at arrest and no other reliable identification was presented.
Confirm whether notarization is required in addition to the sworn attestation.
Confirm the filing channel, fee treatment and any current Seal Team requirement with the Criminal Division.
Confirm and complete service on the prosecuting authority shown by the participant's case record.
